crossRefs.note: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.
Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says Yahweh. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One…
But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you.…

“You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them…
The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;
saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’

translations.web: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”
translations.bsb: You drew near when I called on You; You said, “Do not be afraid.”
translations.kjv: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear
translations.asv: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee; thou saidst, Fear not.
